sentences.en: Methinks my own soul must be a bright invisible green.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的灵魂一定是一种明亮的看不见的绿色。

sentences.en: If I were invisible I wouldn't have to dress myself.
sentences.zh: 如果我隐形了我就不用给自己穿衣服。

sentences.en: If I were invisible, I wouldn't have to wear anything.
sentences.zh: 如果我隐形了我就不用穿任何东西。
